comment: Ballistic Dynamics rifles: twist, barrel and the optic's height over the bore.

provenance.twist_in: published: American Rifleman, The Remington M24 Sniper Weapon System (2016): 5R rifling, one turn in 11.25 in, right hand
provenance.barrel_in: published: American Rifleman (2016), 24 in free-floated barrel
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a 30 mm tube scope in low rings over a Remington 700 action sits about 1.5 to 2 in above the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: SAAMI Z299.4 6.5 Creedmoor drawing, 1 turn in 8 in
provenance.barrel_in: estimated: 24 in, the length Hornady quotes its 6.5 Creedmoor velocities from
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a 30 mm scope in medium rings, 1.5 to 2 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: C.I.P. TDCC .338 Lapua Magnum, twist 254 mm (1 in 10 in)
provenance.barrel_in: estimated: 27 in, typical of .338 LM sniper rifles (AI AWM, Sako TRG-42)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a 34 mm scope on a 20 MOA rail, about 2 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: C.I.P. TDCC 12.7x99 / .50 BMG, twist 381 mm (1 in 15 in)
provenance.barrel_in: published: Barrett M82A1 / M107, 29 in barrel
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a large scope over the M107's rail, about 2.5 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: M16A2 / M4 barrels are rifled 1 turn in 7 in for the M855
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: an optic on a flat-top AR sits about 2.6 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: SAAMI 9 mm Luger, 1 turn in 10 in
provenance.barrel_in: published: Speer quotes 23618GD from a 4 in test barrel
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: iron sights about 0.5 in over the bore of a service pistol

provenance.twist_in: published: .408 CheyTac rifling 1 turn in 13 in (330.2 mm)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: a large tactical scope on the M200's raised rail, about 2.4 in over the bore

rifles.name: Mosin–Nagant M91/30 sniper with the 3.5× PU

provenance.twist_in: published: Mosin–Nagant rifling 1 turn in 240 mm (9.45 in)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the PU on its side mount, centred over the bore about 1.9 in up

provenance.twist_in: published: SVD rifling 1 turn in 240 mm (9.45 in) since 1975 (320 mm before)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the PSO-1 on the left side rail, about 2.7 in over the bore (its small offset to the left is not modelled)

provenance.twist_in: published: (secondary) a factory-pattern G17 barrel listing (Midwest Gun Works): hexagonal right-hand rifling, 250 mm (9.84 in); not checked against Glock's own sheet
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the top of the factory sights about 0.75 in over the bore axis

provenance.twist_in: published: (secondary) 5 in Government .45 barrels, 1 turn in 16 in, left hand (Nighthawk Custom's drop-in barrel); Colt's own rifling is left-hand by tradition, not checked against a Colt sheet
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: GI-pattern sights about 0.7 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: estimated: 1 turn in 18.75 in, right hand, the twist Smith & Wesson revolvers in .357 are commonly listed with; not checked against S&W's sheet
provenance.barrel_in: published: the 686's 4 in barrel (Federal's 4 in vented test barrel matches it)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the ramp front and adjustable rear about 0.75 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: estimated: 1 turn in 231 mm (9.1 in), right hand, the P90's published twist for the same cartridge; the pistol's own figure was not found
provenance.barrel_in: published: FN Five-seveN, 4.8 in barrel (as stated with FN's SS197SR velocity)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: about 0.7 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: H&K MP5 LE brochure: six grooves, right hand; 1 turn in 254 mm (10 in) (other references round it to 250 mm)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the drum rear and hooded front post about 1.4 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: published: FN P90, 1 turn in 231 mm (9.1 in), right hand (FN America lists 1:9 in)
provenance.barrel_in: published: FN P90 technical data, 264 mm (10.4 in)
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the integral ring reflex sight about 1.5 in over the bore

provenance.twist_in: estimated: 1 turn in 16 in, right hand, as Auto-Ordnance's Thompson-pattern carbines are rifled; the wartime M1A1's figure was not found
provenance.sight_height_in: estimated: the fixed L-shaped rear aperture about 1.1 in over the bore
